overview: OpenAI launches faster, cheaper GPT‑6.1 Terra with strong visual and computer‑use abilities
Fanatics leverages OpenAI models to boost e‑commerce engagement
Anthropic’s IPO filing reveals massive compute spend and enterprise growth

top.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Terra
top.summary: OpenAI unveiled GPT‑6.1 Terra, a visual‑reasoning, computer‑use model that runs three times faster and at half the cost of its predecessor, cutting error rates and offering cheaper API pricing for high‑volume tasks.

top.title: How Fanatics and OpenAI streamline the fan experience
top.summary: Fanatics introduced an OpenAI‑powered “Shop the Look” feature that recommends coordinated merchandise, achieving a 10% engagement lift across 30,000 MLB products after a rapid development cycle.

top.title: OpenAI announces three big science discoveries and a new way to work with academics
top.summary: OpenAI released AI‑generated proofs claiming breakthroughs in math, computer science, and physics, and now uses external “shepherds” to guide verification, sparking debate over selective disclosure practices.

top.title: Five weird details from Anthropic’s IPO filing
top.summary: Anthropic filed its S‑1, disclosing executive compensation, personal security costs, and risks including potential catastrophic AI harm and speculative sentience, while outlining billions in compute commitments.

top.title: Anthropic’s IPO filing reveals its strategy for keeping enterprise customers hooked
top.summary: Anthropic’s IPO filing shows over 11,900 enterprise customers spending $100k+, with cross‑product usage driving ~900% net revenue retention and a strategy to lock in spend via integrated apps.

top.title: Anthropic’s IPO Prospectus Reveals What’s Under the Hood
top.summary: Anthropic’s prospectus reveals revenue growth to $16 billion but a $80.7 billion net loss, highlighting compute‑intensive costs, competitive pressures, and extensive risk factors around AI misuse and regulation.
